clauses.name: Sprawling Tentacle
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Sprawling Tentacle is on the field, it gets +1 power if there are at least 4 manifestations in the Confrontation Zone.

clauses.name: Prospero of the Bushes
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Prospero of the Bushes is in the Interzone, the First Manifestation you control gets +1 power for each manifestation in your Interzone.

clauses.name: Herbaceous Whisperer
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Herbaceous Whisperer is on the field, the manifestations in Support you control get +1 power.

clauses.name: Gargullo, King of the Woods
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Gargullo is on the field, each non-token manifestation in Support you control gets +1 power for each other non-token manifestation you control in the Confrontation Zone.

clauses.name: Heartening Monument
clauses.printedParagraph: The manifestations you control get +1 power as long as they are in the Confrontation Zone.

clauses.name: Artificial Thinker
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as there are 5 or more Wills in your Limbo, Artificial Thinker gains Support and, as long as it is in the Confrontation Zone, gets +2 power.

clauses.name: Tipson, the Mediator
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Tipson is in the Confrontation Zone, it gets +1 power for each card in your hand.

clauses.name: Repelling Urn
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as the Repelling Urn is in the Confrontation Zone, it gets +1 power for each manifestation in your Limbo.

clauses.name: Cimba, the Boisterous
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as it is on the field and there is at least one manifestation in a stalemate, Cimba gets +1 power.

clauses.name: Planar Beak
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as the Planar Beak is in the Confrontation Zone, it gets +1 power for each manifestation in stalemate.

clauses.name: Skapus, the Vile
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Skapus is the only manifestation in Support you control, it gets +2 power.

clauses.name: Lucerco the Reckless
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Lucerco the Reckless is in the Confrontation Zone, it gets +1 power for each manifestation in the Confrontation Zone controlled by the opponent who controls the most.

clauses.name: Vengeful Vilupera
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Vengeful Vilupera is in the Confrontation Zone, it gets +1 power for each of your manifestations present in each Empathic Vessel.

clauses.name: Bell, Ardent Fanatic
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Bell is in the Interzone and you control only one manifestation in the Confrontation Zone, that manifestation gets +2 power.

clauses.name: Berta, the Peaceful
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Berta is on the field, the power of other manifestations on the field cannot be reduced below their base power.

clauses.name: Hyperuranic Tower
clauses.printedParagraph: Manifestations you control with one or more Abstraction counters gain Float.

clauses.name: Hyperuranic Tower
clauses.printedParagraph: Manifestations with Float you control on the field get +1 power.

clauses.name: Sangen, the Relic
clauses.printedParagraph: all other Manifestations in its controller's Interzone get -1 power.

clauses.name: Kelona, the Anchorite
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Kelona is in the Confrontation Zone, it gets -1 power for each card in your Limbo, up to a maximum of -6.

clauses.name: Kazadur, the Fiery
clauses.printedParagraph: As long as Kazadur is in the Confrontation Zone, it gets +1 power for each manifestation controlled by opponents in the Confrontation Zone, up to a maximum of +3.

limits: Selected continuous power/Float clauses only; other paragraphs and every interaction are not certified.
Initial zone counts, control changes and comparison snapshots are controlled fixtures, not whole matches.
Paid Defer journeys exercise actual declarations, payments, Stack resolution, owner destinations and both clients public power.
Automatic phase driving disabled in the eleven socket journeys; no new physical-device or remote-artwork certification.
Sensitivity tests mutate encoded rules only in isolated fixtures and verify literal expectations detect the error.
